title: Prove a boundary for staged cold-host recovery
body:
PR2823 leaves staged or precomputed recovery as a concrete missing step toward a profitable cold-host word. This contribution resolves a restricted part of that question: on both pinned `473→277` words, **arbitrary host-only staged recovery after B1201 cannot restore the reference with end rank at most eight**. It extends the contiguous-order obstruction by an information-invisibility proof, not by a larger order census.

The necessary cut coordinate can occur only in registers 100, 67, 112, 169. Each is unreadable by a valid recovery: early reads violate a fixed target end, and late source reads force rank nine. The package includes the precise grammar and endpoint limitation, exact source pins, a rational/frame checker, and a separate explicit-subspace/version-DAG checker. A further necessary-coordinate screen finds that all 22 compatible unchanged retired cold FULL-ended helpers lack original input 100; altered precomputation circuits remain open.

**No improved κ, native supplier or selected-frontier change is claimed.** The useful handoff is to emit a changed information route into an already paid compatible bank before the target barrier, with preloads, arbitrary-dirty compensation, restoration, cleanup, rank-neutral profile/inventory and the inherited tiny net budget all charged. Native, physical stock/precision, chronological owner and outer admission would still follow. The natural-bank screen was not independently reviewed by the separate staged-theorem agent.

Validation:

- Both staged providers, all 756 tail events each, invertible prefixes, positive rank-eight read controls and six rejected semantic mutants pass.
- Independent checker passes 6270 frame nodes per provider and the sparse coordinate propagation.
- Python 3.14.5 normal/optimized receipts agree; staged receipt also matches Python 3.13. All three entrypoints pass a Git-free read-only export with unchanged files. Corrupted vendored engines fail authentication before execution.
- Latest repository metadata/source-pin validation and `git diff --check` pass. Python 3.12 is the registered CI target but unavailable locally; the full registered runner was not run. No hosted CI pass or full selected cold replay is claimed.

Reproduce with Python 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/t74-staged-cold-host-boundary
```

Direct Git-free commands, proof, receipts, scope, cost ledger and open questions are in `research/t74-staged-cold-host-boundary/README.md`.
